lines: I caught <wavy>wind</wavy> of different land {vague_direction}. Could be worth a walk.

I cannot place that story yet.

Good. {target_article} is more than rumor now.

Good. If {target_article} is real, then so are its doors, its fields, and its worries.
You reached {target_article}. I hope they greeted you better than the wilderness did.
{target_article}, confirmed. Old stone is easier to respect when someone comes back from it.

{target_article}. Hm. Some thresholds should be crossed with one foot ready to leave.

{target_article}. I will remember that name with the kind of caution it deserves.

You found {target_article}? The sea hides things, but apparently not from you.
{target_article}, confirmed. I do not trust water that keeps architecture.

{target_article}, then. The ground remembers every hand that tried to hollow it out.

{target_article}. That is a road made by people who forgot roads should see daylight.
{target_article}. Keep that story <pulse>quiet</pulse>. Some places should not hear their own names.
You came back from {target_article}. Speak softly. Even memory might echo down there.
{target_article}, confirmed. That is not a discovery I would celebrate loudly.

{target_article}, confirmed. Towers are louder than they look.
